facts.text: Jsonl_ExportsOnlyLiveFacts omits the superseded text claiming the header is 60 pixels and keeps the text claiming 64 pixels.
Jsonl_EmbedWritesBase64AssetLine expects encoding base64, no path property on the asset line and no assets directory.
Jsonl_DefaultAssetsModeIsFiles asserts that publishing with no options writes the blob file under the assets directory.
When the blob is deleted before publish, the asset line has missing true, no data and no path, and result.Warnings names the sha.
Two facts attached to the same blob produce exactly one asset line in the published bundle.
Two publishes of the same store produce identical files and a bundle_hash of 64 characters in the manifest.
Publishing again after a new fact is posted changes the manifest bundle_hash.
Jsonl_EscapesLineSeparators asserts U+2028, U+2029 and U+0085 are escaped in the data file and restored in the parsed fact text.
A subject scoped publish whose parent lies outside the bundle omits parent from the subject line and records the subject option in the manifest.
A record larger than max file bytes fails with code record_exceeds_max_file_bytes and writes nothing.
Exceeding max files fails with code max_files_exceeded and the message mentions manifest.json.
With a profile alone the max_file_bytes row fails, and adding respect limits makes that row pass and records respect_limits true in the manifest.
Jsonl_WritesSubjectFactAssetLinesAndManifest expects the record types in the order subject,fact,subject,fact,asset,fact,fact.
In Jsonl_WritesSubjectFactAssetLinesAndManifest the manifest file_stats entry for dossier-0001.jsonl reports 7 lines.
With assets none no asset line is written, but the behavior fact still carries the attachment sha256.
A max file bytes value equal to the total line bytes keeps one data file, while one byte less splits the bundle so the second file is dossier-0002.jsonl.
An embedded asset too large for max file bytes fails with record_exceeds_max_file_bytes and the message names the sha and --assets files.
A total byte count one below the limit fails with code max_total_bytes_exceeded and nothing is written.
An asset file larger than max file bytes fails with record_exceeds_max_file_bytes and the message names assets/.
A tighter profile limit is not enforced without respect limits even when a larger max file bytes flag is passed, so the publish keeps one data file.
Under respect limits an allowed_extensions miss fails closed with code profile_extension_not_allowed and writes nothing.
A min_file_bytes profile miss is report only: the row fails but the publish still writes one data file.
Respect limits without a profile path fails with code invalid_profile.
Markdown publishing ignores the format option: the manifest format is the integer 1 and no file name ends with .jsonl.
An unknown format fails with invalid_format and a negative max files fails with invalid_limit.
The jsonl CLI publish exits 0 and the manifest options record max_file_bytes 5000000.
Passing budget, budget-mode, depth, facts or index-max-tokens with format jsonl exits 1 and names markdown on stderr.
An assets value outside the format's allowed set errors with embed|files|none for jsonl and detail|none for markdown.
The Types helper maps Jsonl.Records of a directory to the type string of each record.
PackingStore publishes a probe bundle and measures each line as its UTF-8 byte count plus one, so a later limit can be exact.
FactRows selects id, subject_id, kind, key, text, data, items, tags, confidence, status, provenance and content_hash from facts ordered by id.
at: SELECT id, subject_id, kind, key, text, data, items, tags, confidence, status, provenance, content_hash FROM facts ORDER BY id

facts.text: RefRows selects the refs table columns from fact_id onward and orders the rows by fact_id then seq.
at: SELECT fact_id, seq, rel, kind, target, basis, confidence, rev, locator

facts.text: SubjectRows selects id, name, kind, parent_id, aliases and pin from subjects ordered by id.
at: SELECT id, name, kind, parent_id, aliases, pin FROM subjects ORDER BY id

facts.text: Tamper rewrites dossier-0001.jsonl and, unless told otherwise, rewrites the manifest file_stats bytes, lines and sha256 to match.
EditManifest parses manifest.json, applies the edit and writes the manifest back with Jsonl.Utf8.
The Line helper selects the nth line of dossier-0001.jsonl whose text contains the quoted type field.
The Sha helper returns the SHA256 of the bytes as a lowercase hex string.
RoundTrip_RestoresFactsRefsSubjectsAndCompileSearchOutput expects 2 subjects, 4 refs and 1 attachment from the import.
In assets none mode the imported store gets no blob and the import reports one skip whose reason contains absent.
Republishing the imported store reproduces the exported dossier-0001.jsonl byte for byte.
RoundTrip_MarkdownRepublishOfImportedStoreMatches compares the fact files and index.md of the original and imported stores as equal text.
An imported subject whose parent was outside the bundle has a null parent_id in the target store.
at: SELECT parent_id FROM subjects WHERE id = $i

facts.text: Publishing with max file bytes 1400 yields more than two data files, and importing them reports 4 facts and 1 blob.
Import_UnicodeSeparatorsSurvive expects the imported fact rows to equal the source fact rows exactly.
A copied extra data file is rejected with import_unlisted_file and leaves the target store with 0 facts.
A listed data file absent from file_stats fails with import_file_mismatch, and a listed file missing on disk fails with import_file_missing.
A same-length content edit is caught by the sha256 check and reported as import_file_mismatch.
Stripping the final newline of a data file fails with import_file_mismatch even when the refreshed stats match it.
Manifest format dossier-jsonl/99 fails with unsupported_bundle_format, and adding ../../etc/hosts to files fails with import_unlisted_file.
A data file replaced by a symbolic link is rejected with import_unsafe_path and imports no facts.
Importing with MaxLineBytes 300 fails with import_line_too_long and the message names the file and its position.
Appending a non-JSON line fails with import_bad_record, and appending a duplicate fact line fails with import_duplicate_id.
An unknown record type future is skipped with that name in the reason, and the import still reports 4 facts.
A fact line carrying only id and type is skipped with a reason containing lacks, and the import still reports 4 facts.
A path traversal asset path that hashes correctly is still skipped with a path reason and no blob is written.
An asset path inside the bundle that is not the generated name is skipped even when its bytes hash correctly.
Replacing the embedded base64 with other bytes of equal length skips the asset for sha256 mismatch while 4 facts import.
Truncated or padded base64, a wrong encoding, non-base64 data and a declared size over MaxEmbedAssetBytes are each skipped with a matching reason.
Replacing the sha with ../../evil leaves the blob root empty and creates no evil file.
A blob missing at publish time is skipped with a reason containing missing while 4 facts and 1 attachment still import.
Importing a bundle published in the markdown format still reports 4 facts.
The CLI import of a jsonl publish exits 0 and prints a summary containing facts 4.
A symlinked asset file is skipped with a reason containing symbolic link and no blob is written.
Tampered asset file bytes in files mode are skipped with a sha256 reason and no blob is written.
